title: e2e test: explain blank_pos+2 header insertion offset
description:
In did_sig_e2e.rs, both test cases use 'blank_pos + 2' to insert the DID-Sig header line, where blank_pos is the index of the start of the '

' sequence. The +2 skips past the '
' of the last real header to land at the start of the blank-line '
'. This is non-obvious: a new reader may think blank_pos is the start of the blank line itself, or wonder why not +4. The offset should have a brief inline comment, and the repeated pattern (it appears in both test cases) is a candidate for extraction into a helper.
